findings.title: Nested child failure unwinds DB fixture before owned descendant settlement
findings.mechanism: subprocess.run(timeout=...) kills/waits only its direct pytest leader. The timeout handler checkpoints UNCERTAIN then immediately raises. Producer signal exits and unrecognized positive exits merely checkpoint a returncode then raise without even recording UNCERTAIN. None of these paths positively settles the descendant family or fences the empty_database_url finalizer. That existing generator finalizer immediately attempts DROP DATABASE. The outer run_gate may settle descendants later, but that eventual readback cannot prove that destructive inner teardown was ordered after settlement. A killed old pytest leader cannot run its authentic host/runtime finally blocks.
